text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Make way, the King has entered the venue!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
From here, she would stir up the paddock
and drive the crowd wild in the race.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, for a first-rate Umamusume,
everything is effortless.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —First place is mine, even without aiming for it!
